meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of complaints consumers filed with the CFPB, kept for marketing planning. A complaint is a report, not a finding that anyone broke a law, and no company name, narrative or ZIP code is published. Debt-collection and credit-reporting rules are for your own counsel.
